rawFindings.title: Local file dependencies are no longer cacheable in force mode, but _resolve still always stores them
rawFindings.explanation: This new early return bypasses the existing force-path behavior for local dependencies, but the later _resolve path still unconditionally writes resolved packages into the resolve cache. A call like fetch({source: './path/to/pkg', ...}) with config.force=true will now skip the force cache-write path entirely and resolve without persisting through the normal forced-cache flow expected by the rest of fetch, which can leave subsequent reads out of sync with the advertised 'write to cache anyway' se
rawFindings.suggestion: If local dependencies must bypass cache lookup, keep the force handling separate: allow the force branch to run after the non-cacheable check when force is set, or document/adjust _resolve so it consistently performs the intended cache write for local sources.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: With config.force=true and a local dependency source like './packages/a', fetch() now returns a resolved package without going through the forced cache path, so a later fetch of the same endpoint does not reuse the cached entry as expected.
